claims.claim: The work is generally reckoned among the most trustworthy of the Martyria.
Nothing is known as to the date or authorship of the narrative.
Crescens, a cynic, has the ill-renown of stirring up the persecution in which Justin and his friends suffered for Christ.
The martyrdom took place at Rome under the prefect Rusticus.
Wicked decrees were passed against Christians to force them to offer libations to vain idols.
The martyrs included Justin, Chariton, Charites, Paeon, and Liberianus according to some versions, while another version includes Euelpistus and Hierax among seven companions.
An absurd addition was in some copies made to the effect that Justin died by means of hemlock.
Some have thought it necessary to conceive of two Justins because of the hemlock story.
